summary:
With the season just a week away, the division is in its final throes of preparation, and the activity across the league tells an interesting story.

Eccleshall continue to look the part as champions-elect. They've wrapped up their pre-season with a settled squad, having confirmed Nicky Parker as captain with Levi Hunter and Adam Whitehouse as vice-captains. It's the kind of stability you'd expect from a side that finished 11 points clear last time out.

The most striking squad activity is at Foley Meir, who appear to be making wholesale changes after finishing 11th last season. They've announced a string of signings across the week — Archie Ellams, Monty Parks, Nick Woods, Connor Lawton, Tyler Mistry, Conor Withers, Eden Bullock, Zach Robinson, Freddy Lloyd, Jake Walklett and others. It's an unusual amount of turnover for a mid-table club and suggests they've identified significant room for improvement.

Stafford Town had an excellent pre-season result on Friday, dismantling Cradley Town 6-3 in an entertaining display. They've also promoted two academy players to first-team forms. They face Barnton next weekend in their opening fixture.

Telford Town showed some resilience in drawing 2-2 away at Stourport after going behind, scoring twice in the final minutes to salvage the result. Barring that one comeback, it's been a solid if unspectacular pre-season.

Sandbach themselves have been active on recruitment, bringing in new players and kits while seeking sponsorship, positioning themselves for another push after finishing sixth last season.

The standout damp squib is Cheadle Heath Nomads, who lost their last friendly to Woolton without scoring. After finishing ninth last season, they'll need to find more attacking punch.
